'''Senior Counselor''' was a title that was held by [[Barnab Chistor]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
